title: Semantic Modeling for LLM projects
description: Learn how semantic modeling enhances Large Language Model (LLM) projects by improving accuracy, grounding, reasoning, and structure.

title: Learn Semantic Modeling and Their Use
description: Learn what semantic modeling is, its benefits, use cases, and examples in e-commerce and finance. Semantic modeling structures data by capturing its real-world meaning, relationships, and context, enabling smarter data integration and analytics. In e-commerce, it maps customers, orders, and products for personalized experiences and operational insights. In finance, it links customers, accounts, and transactions to enhance compliance, risk detection, and financial intelligence.

title: Semantic Modeling with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
description: Learn how semantic modeling enhances Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) by improving relevance, context, and grounding.
